description: Captures the initial title-screen framebuffer from a reference Chocolate Doom 2.2.1 run of doom/DOOM.EXE with doom/DOOM1.WAD. The capture pins the first stable title-screen tic, the SHA-256 hash of the raw 320x200 palette-indexed framebuffer at that tic, and the active PLAYPAL palette index. Initial entries are empty and require an external sandboxed reference run; the schema follows 02-011 define-framebuffer-capture-format.
captureMethod: Launch doom/DOOM.EXE -iwad doom/DOOM1.WAD inside the read-only sandbox defined by 02-003; wait for I_InitStretchTables to finish (per 02-016); after the title screen stabilizes (tic 35 or later), grab the 320x200 palette-indexed framebuffer via a host-side capture utility, compute SHA-256, and record the active palette index (always 0 on the title screen).
